executor.skill: Prepare Chirograph for a future FOSS release without changing repository visibility. Use Apache-2.0 as the project-wide default license and add the legal/public trust skeleton discussed with the owner: LICENSE, NOTICE when appropriate, CONTRIBUTING.md with DCO sign-off, SECURITY.md covering untrusted-source parsing and execution/network/privacy boundaries, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, and machine-readable license/provenance policy suitable for benchmark fixtures and third-party specimens. Update Cargo package metadata to declare Apache-2.0 where publishable. Add concise public docs for concepts, guarantees/epistemic boundaries, evidence model, adapter authoring, and benchmark methodology, reusing and linking existing docs rather than duplicating them. Update README navigation and positioning. Add practical license/provenance validation to CI if it can be done cleanly without embedding specimen-specific logic. Preserve third-party upstream licenses and provenance; do not relicense copied specimens. Keep Chirograph core general-purpose and do not add specimen-specific benchmark code. Run the repository's full formatting/check/test/clippy suite plus any new metadata/license checks. Finish with exact commit/PR/test evidence and do not make the repository public as part of this transition.

Implement a generic Java acquisition adapter for Chirograph using Tree-sitter Java, not Kafka-specific parsing. Keep parsing language-aware and framework-agnostic. Introduce deterministic provenance-rich Java facts/observations for a narrow useful v0 covering declarations/constants/literals, method calls, conditionals/throws, comments or documentation associations, and test assertions where safely extractable. Emit or support ordinary chirograph-evidence-v1 rather than adding Java concepts to chirograph-core. Use the existing Kafka producer-idempotence field test at exact upstream revision 5e3bc31a7dbc354155932e38ab35d11dd71b97bf as the acceptance specimen: automate meaningful evidence acquisition that previously required hand-authored JSON, preserve exact source revision/location provenance, and ensure Chirograph still exposes the documented max.in.flight fallback disagreement as CONTESTED. Prefer a small, testable adapter over whole-program semantic analysis; do not implement a Java parser. Add tests and CI coverage, document capability and limitations, and finish with exact commit/PR/CI evidence.

Implement a generic Python acquisition adapter for Chirograph using tree-sitter-python in the Rust workspace. Keep parsing language-aware and framework-agnostic. Provide deterministic provenance-rich Python facts/observations for a narrow useful v0 covering module/class/function declarations, annotated assignments and type expressions, decorators and decorator arguments, calls, returns/raises/conditionals, comments/docstrings where safely associable, and test assertions where useful. Preserve exact byte/source locations and exact repository revision provenance. Emit or support ordinary chirograph-evidence-v1 without adding Python concepts to chirograph-core. Use TDD, add adapter documentation and CI coverage, and do not depend on a CPython runtime merely to parse source.

Implement Task 2 of docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-03-tree-sitter-rust-cargo-slice.md using TDD. Build the generic chirograph-rust adapter on the shared Tree-sitter substrate, emitting deterministic provenance-rich source-local Rust facts only. Do not add Cargo-specific symbols, clause stances, macro expansion, name resolution, trait solving, or cross-file inference. Run the plan's exact verification commands and finish with exact commit and test evidence.

Implement Task 1 of docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-03-tree-sitter-rust-cargo-slice.md using TDD. Add the shared chirograph-tree-sitter Rust crate for caller-supplied source bytes/provenance, exact spans, deterministic traversal, and parse diagnostics. Keep chirograph-core Tree-sitter-free and language-agnostic. Perform no network, Git, or repository discovery inside the substrate. Run the plan's exact verification commands and finish with exact commit and test evidence.

Retire adapters/pydantic as bespoke production extraction machinery and turn Pydantic into a specimen exercising generic Chirograph capabilities. Replace its hard-coded static source observations with the generic tree-sitter Python adapter. Preserve genuinely executable Pydantic evidence such as model_validate, model_json_schema validation/serialization perspectives, model_dump, and exact runtime/package revision evidence through a generic Python/runtime probe boundary rather than Pydantic-specific core concepts. Keep the stale validation-schema contradiction fixture and preserve the same perspective-sensitive CONTESTED behavior. Prefer deleting bespoke Pydantic code over reproducing it elsewhere. Add equivalence/regression tests, update docs/layout, run full CI, and finish with exact commit/PR/CI evidence.

Extend the generic Tree-sitter Java adapter with a small deterministic evidence-candidate layer. Do not infer clause truth or supports/contradicts stances. Given language-level Java facts plus a semantic query, mechanically tokenize and normalize identifiers/text, rank facts by relevant term overlap and useful fact kind, and return provenance-preserving candidate observations for higher-level Chirograph or agent judgment. Keep project-specific concepts out of chirograph-core and adapters/java. Update the Kafka idempotence acceptance specimen so it discovers the documentation and validator evidence through the generic candidate layer rather than hard-coded Kafka symbol/condition names, while still producing ordinary chirograph-evidence-v1 and the same CONTESTED clause. Use TDD, add generic ranking tests including false-positive resistance, keep exact revision/source locations, run full CI, and finish with exact commit/PR/CI evidence.

Implement Task 3 of docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-03-tree-sitter-rust-cargo-slice.md. Add benchmarks/cargo/schema-enum-drift using exact Cargo revision 2ceefa0090080354b80cc2f5415039bdb0d2bf0b and the two pinned SHA-256 fixture digests documented in the plan. Acquire the Rust side through the generic adapter, parse the generated schema through serde_json, keep Cargo-specific stance mapping in the benchmark layer, and require ordinary chirograph-evidence-v1 to assess the clause CONTESTED. Runtime source retrieval is not part of benchmark scoring. Run the full repository verification suite and finish with exact revision/hash/test/commit evidence.

Stress-test Chirograph against Apache Kafka at exact upstream revision 5e3bc31a7dbc354155932e38ab35d11dd71b97bf. Select a compact but genuinely cross-represented Kafka contract with documentation, implementation, tests, and/or protocol/schema representations. Collect source-backed observations at exact revisions, encode them as chirograph-evidence-v1, run the current Chirograph inspector, and evaluate what it exposes or fails to represent across structural, executable, semantic, failure, concurrency, recovery, and verification facets. Preserve contradictions rather than smoothing them over. Add a durable Kafka case study/fixture and tests to the Chirograph repository when justified; make only generalizable Chirograph fixes revealed by the exercise. Finish with evidence of the exact Kafka revision, Chirograph revision, commands/tests run, output, model gaps, and any code changes.
